speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: CMV Retinitis. The findings of granular yellow-white opacities (retinitis) combined with dot-blot hemorrhages ("pizza-pie" appearance) in an AIDS patient are classic for Cytomegalovirus retinitis. I request images of the fundus to document the extent of the necrosis before we proceed with antiviral treatment.
